column2: Listen, friend. When the rain comes, a fighter wants a roof. There is a door that leads indoors about sixty paces east of here.
Mind yourself, friend. The dead walk outside Lilmoth's walls. There are walking dead about a hundred paces north-north-west of here. I would not go to them with empty hands.
Lilmoth Dock lies about eighty paces north-east of here. Go and see it, but the council's guards at the gate called us unlicensed blades and turned us away.
I am Breaks-The-Oar, friend. My fists belong to whoever pays the band. I am the one who talks terms. Have you work this week?

The band is camped here, friend. Keeps-Both-Edges is about five paces west of me. I trust him with my life and my purse. Heem-Tsal the fire mage is about ten paces west-south-west. He is cleverer than the rest of us, and too proud for his own good.
